text: Moss Lindqvist. Sixteen kyu, three years running, and the ceiling of the section is fifteen.
That's the trick. I'm not proud of it.
You don't know the rules, and you want me to teach them. No. Wren does that, down the steps.
No rank? Then there's nothing to play for, and I don't play for nothing. Kesh, at De Ketel, will give you one.
Look at you. Out of the section already. I've spent three years staying under it.
One game, and it counts. On your card and on mine.

exit.intro: He clears the folding table with his forearm, the only fast thing he does all evening.

text: Then we've nothing to talk about, and I mean that kindly. Come back when you want one that counts.
There. Now the record says something different about both of us.
Still sixteen kyu. That's not modesty. A rank is a record, and mine is accurate.
